Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator incorrectly mapped the parameters from the Excel data to the Michaelis–Menten equation, treating the catalytic constant (k_cat) as Vmax and using an incorrect substrate concentration ([S] = 72.3). This misinterpretation of the final equation and misassignment of values (without verifying the extracted Reaction 7 data) led to computing 0.0429 instead of the correct 0.0424.
